hints.title: Denary Prefix Tree
hints.text: Numbers ordered lexicographically form a 10-ary tree where children of node x are 10x through 10x plus 9.

hints.title: Subtree Size Calculation
hints.text: Compute how many numbers with prefix curr exist up to n by taking intervals [curr, curr+1) multiplied by 10 per level.

hints.title: Skipping Subtrees or Descending Deeper
hints.text: If subtree size at curr is <= k, the target is not in this subtree: add subtree size to k and advance to curr + 1. Otherwise, target is inside this subtree: decrement k by 1 and advance to curr * 10.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findKthNumber(self, n: int, k: int) -> int:
        curr = 1
        k -= 1

        def count_steps(prefix: int) -> int:
            steps = 0
            first = prefix
            last = prefix
            while first <= n:
                steps += min(n + 1, last + 1) - first
                first *= 10
                last = last * 10 + 9
            return steps

        while k > 0:
            steps = count_steps(curr)
            if steps <= k:
                curr += 1
                k -= steps
            else:
                curr *= 10
                k -= 1

        return curr
```

complexity.notes: Traversal explores down digits with log N interval counting per step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all numbers or string sorting takes O(N log N) time and exceeds memory limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting subtrees mathematically executes in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model decimal prefixes as a trie and skip entire subtrees in O(log N) time.
